title: Aromatic Syrian Lamb Wrap
description: A flavorful and earthy Syrian dish featuring lamb, dried oregano, and ssam wrap, perfect for meal prep, and paleo friendly. This recipe is a hearty and satisfying meal option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together dried oregano, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the mixture all over the lamb shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook for 20 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked to 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the lamb rest for 10 minutes before slicing it thinly.
Assemble the wraps by slicing the lamb and placing it in the ssam wrap, along with chopped onion and minced garlic.
